title: Switch
description: Toggles a single setting on or off, with immediate effect.

support.notes: Controlled/default checked state with real native widget rollback, slider/segmented variants, sizes/colors/shapes, dual labels/placement, loading, icon slots and custom track/thumb styles. Native switch supplies form/touch behavior beneath token-styled track/thumb; browser focus/ripple event geometry differs. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

translationResources.title: Switch
translationResources.description: Toggles a single setting on or off, with immediate effect.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Uncontrolled switches with a label; defaultChecked sets the initial state.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Use checked together with onChange to drive the switch from your state.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color takes a semantic color for the checked state: primary (default), success, info, warning or danger.

label-placement.title: Label placement
label-placement.description: Place the label before ("start"), after ("end", default), above ("top") or below ("bottom") the switch with labelPlacement.

states.title: Loading and disabled
states.description: loading shows a busy state and, like disabled, blocks interaction.

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Render a small icon inside the thumb with icon.

custom-style.title: Shape and custom styles
custom-style.description: Square shape, no ripple, and custom trackStyle / thumbStyle.

bilateral-and-segmented.title: Side labels and segmented
bilateral-and-segmented.description: offLabel and onLabel render clickable labels on both sides of the slider; variant="segmented" turns them into a two-segment control.

SwitchProps.color: Semantic color of the "on" state (checked thumb and track, active side label / segment)
SwitchProps.shape: Shape of the track and thumb
SwitchProps.label: Label displayed next to the switch
SwitchProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when the switch has no visible label
SwitchProps.name: Name of the input, used in forms
SwitchProps.labelPlacement: Position of the label relative to the switch
SwitchProps.loading: Shows a loading state and blocks interaction
SwitchProps.ripple: Shows a ripple effect on click
SwitchProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
SwitchProps.onFocus: Called when the switch receives focus
SwitchProps.onBlur: Called when the switch loses focus
SwitchProps.iconPlacement: Icon position: inside the thumb ("start") or after the switch ("end")
SwitchProps.ref: Ref to the underlying <input role="switch"> element
SwitchProps.variant: "slider" is the classic track + thumb; "segmented" renders two pressable segments (requires offLabel and onLabel)
SwitchProps.children: Label content (alternative to label; used when label is not set)
SwitchProps.offLabel: Label of the "off" state; with onLabel, rendered as side buttons or as segments
SwitchProps.id: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)
SwitchProps.value: Value submitted with the form when on
SwitchProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the switch (the segment group for the segmented variant)
SwitchProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the switch (the segment group for the segmented variant) (merged with the helper / error text)

cssVars.--switch-thumb-size: Width and height of the thumb (every size)
cssVars.--switch-checked-color: Accent of the checked thumb, track and active segment (defaults to the color prop's accent)
cssVars.--switch-label-gap: Space between the switch and its label
cssVars.--switch-label-font-size: Font size of the label (every size)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A native checkbox with role="switch": Space and Enter toggle it, and minerva-change reports the new state.

styles-states.title: Styles and states
styles-states.description: Sizes, square shape, colors, label placement, an icon in the thumb, and the read-only, invalid and no-ripple variants. Toggling Sync shows the loading state.

side-labels.title: Side labels and segments
side-labels.description: off-label and on-label add clickable labels on both sides of the slider; variant="segmented" turns them into a two-segment control.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Like a checkbox: a switch that is on submits its value, required keeps the form invalid until it is on, and reset restores the checked attributes.

props.noRipple: Disables the ripple effect on click.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but the user cannot toggle it.
props.required: The switch must be on for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The state changed (re-dispatched from the inner input).
events.minerva-change: The user toggled the switch; detail: { checked, value }.

slots.default: Label content (alternative to the label attribute).
slots.icon: Icon inside the thumb (icon-placement="start") or after the switch ("end").

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.click: Clicks the inner input (toggles the switch unless it is blocked).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
